* Generate DEVICE_IDENTITY Notify payload. * *

This method formats the given device identity string to its payload format. * * @see TS 124 302, Fig/Table 8.2.9.2 for specification of DEVICE_IDENTITY Notify payload. * @param deviceIdentity the device identity (IMEI/IMEISV) * @return the formatted DEVICE_IDENTITY Notify payload data as a byte array.
